desc: From EZ-Reach forends located closer to the receiver to its innovative super bantam stock spacer adjustment system designed to grow with the shooter, Mossberg is one of the industry's strongest advocates for promoting safe, enjoyable youth recreational shooting. EZ-Reach Forends, Reduced Length of Pull, Shorter Barrels and Adjustable Stocks designed to grow with the user. Dual extractors, positive steel-to-steel lockup, twin action bars, and an anti-jam elevator ensure smooth operation. Top mounted safety provides for ambidextrous operation.
